title: Enrollment in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program — Desk Guidance
content:
Finch Circle Loyalty Program membership is free. The applicant is at least the minimum member age in years on the enrollment date, and the customer profile carries every identifier required for enrollment (the minimum age and the identifiers are set in the program's enrollment terms). A membership starts as Finch Circle Member, or at the card-floor tier set by the tier qualification rule when the customer holds a qualifying card status on the enrollment date. The tier's enrollment bonus points (the Finch Circle Member value) post once, on the enrollment date, as an enrollment bonus entry on the points history; a customer who has held any earlier membership receives no enrollment bonus. Purchases made before the enrolled date earn no points, not even through a missing-points request.

## What decides eligibility

| Point | Where it is read | Satisfied when |
|---|---|---|
| Age | the date of birth on the customer profile | the applicant is at least the minimum age on the enrollment date |
| Identifiers | the phone number and email on the customer profile of the customer enrolling | the profile carries every required identifier |

Both points are read from the company's customer profile of the customer being enrolled, as it stands before the enrollment; the applicant's own statement does not replace the profile record.

## Starting tier and bonus

- Starting tier: Finch Circle Member, or the card-floor tier when a qualifying card status is held on the enrollment date.
- Enrollment bonus: posted once on the enrollment date, at the Finch Circle Member value, to a customer who has never held a membership before.
- Earlier purchases: a purchase dated before the enrolled date never earns points, whether at checkout or through a later missing-points request.

## Cases (hypothetical, with a minimum age of 13)

- An applicant whose 13th birthday falls on the enrollment date meets the age point; one whose 13th birthday is the following day does not.
- A former member returning after cancelling starts a new membership without the enrollment bonus.
- A purchase made the day before the enrolled date earns no points, including on a missing-points request.
